module: Extension that manages the speed cameras and red light cameras placed in levels as BeamNGTrigger triggers carrying a speedTrapType field ("speed" or "redLight"). When a vehicle enters the trigger, in the right direction and too fast, it emits the hooks onSpeedTrapTriggered or onRedLightCamTriggered and makes the associated light flash. Inactive during a foreground mission.
notes: Data expected in data: event ('enter'), speedTrapType, speedLimit (m/s), speedLimitTolerance (default 10% of the limit), speedTrapLightName, subjectID, triggerID, triggerName; for a red light: triggerSpeed (default 5 m/s) and trafficSignalId.
Speed camera: triggered if the speed exceeds limit + tolerance. Red light camera: triggered if the speed exceeds triggerSpeed AND the signal is "redTrafficLight".
Ignored if the vehicle is more than 100 m from the camera or if the vehicle is driving in the opposite direction to the trigger's Y axis.
The flash lasts 0.1 s (speed camera); for a red light: flash 0.1 s, pause of 10 / speed s, second flash 0.1 s.
For a red light camera, trafficSignal is used without a nil check: if trafficSignalId is invalid, Lua error.

onBeamNGTrigger.desc: Hook called by the engine on each BeamNGTrigger event. Only handles triggers with speedTrapType and the 'enter' event. Computes the vehicle speed, checks the direction of passage and emits onSpeedTrapTriggered(data, vehSpeed, overSpeed) or onRedLightCamTriggered(data, vehSpeed), then turns on the named light.

getSpeedTrapsInCurrentLevel.desc: Lists the BeamNGTrigger triggers of the current level whose speedTrapType matches.
